title: Sumac Chicken Traybake with Tahini Yoghurt
description: Spiced chicken roasted on one tray with potatoes, carrot, broccoli and asparagus, finished with a lemony tahini yoghurt. Untested, so report back and I will adjust the timings.

confidence.note: Own recipe, first draft. Untested, so report back and I will adjust the timings.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan-forced) and line a large tray with baking paper.

Butterfly or slice the chicken ({{chicken}} breasts) to an even 2cm thickness. Mix 1 tsp of the sumac, the cumin ({{cumin}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}), half the garlic ({{garlic*0.5}} clove), the lemon zest, 1 tbsp of the olive oil and ½ tsp of the salt. Coat the chicken and set aside.
Toss the potatoes ({{potatoes}}) and carrot ({{carrot}}) with 1 tbsp olive oil, the remaining salt ({{salt*0.5}}) and the pepper ({{pepper}}). Spread in a single layer and roast 20 minutes.
Toss the broccoli ({{broccoli}}) in the last 1 tbsp olive oil and add to the tray. Push the veg aside and lay the chicken flat in the gaps. Roast 15 minutes.
Add the asparagus ({{asparagus}} bunch) and roast a further 8–10 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part and the potatoes are golden.

Rest the chicken 5 minutes. Meanwhile whisk the yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}), tahini ({{tahini}}), the remaining garlic, juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt, loosening with a splash of water until drizzly.

Slice the chicken and plate with the veg. Drizzle with the tahini yoghurt, then finish with the remaining sumac (approx. {{sumac*0.5}}), the parsley ({{parsley}}) and the other lemon half cut into wedges.

notes.title: Confidence
notes.text: Amounts and timings are estimates. The 75°C internal temperature is the standard Australian poultry guideline. Watch the chicken at the 20-minute mark after it goes in.

notes.title: Crowding
notes.text: The main risk. If the tray is full, use two trays so the veg roasts rather than steams.

notes.title: Air fryer
notes.text: Works for a half batch on the usual staged method: potatoes and carrot at 200°C first, chicken later at 180°C.

notes.title: Tahini
notes.text: Shelved in either the spreads or the health food aisle, so check both.
